reviews.text: Greatest team ever! They took such good care of our baby while we were gone away:) They kept our cat for a month and sent us daily updates and gave lots of cuddles and play time. Thank you all so much...
This is a very special place where staff and leadership understand each dog and create a loving community.
Came in from out of town and needed to board our dog.  The staff were awesome, professional and really cared about our dog's experience.  Very pleased with this business.
Wonderful people! Been bringing my dog here for 6 years. Consistently great and friendly service!

We take Dylan and Luca to D Pet Hotel in Hollywood every time we travel.  The dogs love going there and we know they will be treated wonderfully.  The staff if friendly, knowledgable and caring.  The facility is sparkling clean.  Both dogs are on a special diet and the staff handles their feeding with care and accuracy every day.  I would highly recommend D Pet Hotel for boarding, daycare and grooming to anyone who wants to ensure that their dogs are being taken care of with the highest level of care.

Absolutely amazing! These folks really go above and beyond.  Our little Scottish Terrier, Toto, is always so happy in the pictures which they send every day that he is there, and I can tell he really enjoyed himself every time I pick him up. An easy five stars!
I always know Franz is in good hands whenever I leave him here. Attentive and caring staff! They send updates and photos too!!

We had a wonderful experience with D Pet Hotel! Our dog, Sadie stayed for three nights, and the staff took excellent care of her. Since Sadie is new to D Pet Hotel, we were a little nervous. But they made her feel comfortable and well cared for from the very beginning.

Amber has been especially sweet to Sadie since her very first visit. I haven't learned all of the staff's names yet, but it's clear that everyone has been kind and caring. Amber is definitely Sadie's favorite, and it's so comforting to know she's excited to see someone she trusts.

It gave us great peace of mind knowing she was in such caring hands while we were away. We truly appreciate the kindness, attention, and love they showed Sadie. We highly recommend D Pet Hotel to anyone looking for a safe, caring, and trustworthy place to board their dog. We'll definitely be bringing Sadie back!
Wonderful care and my dog had a blast!

I’m so glad I found this place, they take such good care of my elderly French bulldog. He had a spinal injury and I’m thankful for their private care. Highly recommend, the staff are so personable and love my dog.

The staff and facility are amazing! I always feel at ease leaving my dog here knowing He’s in good hands. Thank you D Pet Hollywood for being so accommodating and providing a great safe space for my dog to stay and engage with other dogs!

Omg how I love this place. We have been taking our puppy there since her vaccines kicked in, and she LOVES it. She literally runs once she sees the door, and pulls the leash so hard because she's so excited to go there. They clearly love her and love all their dogs. They know all their names and speak of them all with affection. It's heartwarming to see, like a family. The owner is the nicest person, and always so responsive and helpful. They send pics throughout the day and they will give you even more updates if you ask for them. Clean environment and so safe. It's so nice to know that I can drop our fur baby off at a place where she is having a blast and where she will be loved and taken care of. We won't take her anywhere else!

We had such a great experience with D Pet Hotels Hollywood!

Nolan stayed for boarding and truly did an amazing job. The staff kept me updated and let me know he was eating all his meals, sleeping well at night, and playing happily with other big dogs his size. It meant so much knowing he was comfortable and well cared for while I was away.

When I picked him up, he looked great (and smelled amazing after his bath and nail trim!). The funniest part? He loved it so much that he tried to head back toward the daycare area instead of leaving with me!

It’s clear the team genuinely cares about the dogs and creates a positive, structured environment. We will absolutely be back for both daycare and future boarding. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a safe, clean, and professional place for their pup.
Thank you, Blake, for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are glad you had a great experience. If you need anything in the future, please let us know.

I started day care and the odd overnight with D Pet Hotels 3 months ago. The staff are incredibly professional, efficient, kind and patient. The facility is clean , bright, updated and even has a large Hepa air cleaner to keep the air fresh. I was with WAG hotels for 3 years but after I started to get a uncomfortable feeling about a number of things not to mention their painfully slow dog pickup I decided to make the switch to D-Hotel. I want 100% confidence that my dog is safe and well cared for and D-Hotel delivers on that !
Thank you, D Washington! We truly appreciate your 5-star rating and are glad you had a great experience. We look forward to serving you again soon.
Hands down the best daycare/boarding facility in the area. The staff are all great and clearly love dogs.

Skippy has been coming here for a few months. When he first joined, I was so nervous because he doesn't pass evaluation tests very well as he's not particularly friendly with other dogs. Josh, the owner, took a chance on Skippy and now he absolutely loves going and the staff know how to handle him perfectly and the pictures I get reaffirm my confidence in D Pet Hotels Hollywood.

I bring my dog Ashton here and have had the best experience! He’s always excited to come, and the staff is incredibly attentive and caring. They provide a structured, safe environment where the dogs can play and socialize. I’ve tried multiple dog daycares in the area, and none compare — this place truly stands out.!!

I wrote a review a few weeks ago in which I complimented this Day Care as a very nice place to take my dog to. A week after that my dog got bitten by another dog, where the way they're dealing with the situation very DISHONESTLY! Now I simply wanted to take my prior review off, but I didn't have an edit option to do so.
Therefore I need to write this to come clean with myself and to whomever that cares.
P.S. They don't deserve that 1 star either, but that's the only way one's able to post anything!

Needed a place to leave my cat that could monitor him 24/7 since he needs medication once every 12 hours.  D pet hotels was able to accommodate my cats needs and also sent photos every day of pekoms having some quality play time with some of the workers.  The benefit is that people are on site 24/7 so this place definitely helped us out and exceeded our expectations.  We left him for 5 days and definitely would bring him back if we have to leave town again

We’ve used other doggie daycares in the past and D Pet Hotels Hollywood is hands down the best. They clearly love our pup so much so we always know she’s going to be well taken care of in the best of hands. We couldn’t recommend it more!
The amazing staff took the best care of my cat. They sent me daily photos and updates. 10/10 would recommend.

I leave my dog Bentley here every few months when I go out of town - they take the best care of him and he always come back happy and satisfied! They also provide pictures and updates daily for peace of mind. Such a great place!

A very Lovely place ran by very lovely people! A  Place I can easily leave My Dog for as long as I need to!  Thank You So Much Very Much, Tyler And Amber
Kindly,
Ali P

We send our little buddy here from time to time- the staff always sends us cute photo updates and he loves having friends to play with while we’re away. Very easy drop off/pickup process and friendly staff

I’ve been bringing my dog Pierre to D Pet Hotel Hollywood for over five years. The staff is amazing. They really get to know the individual dogs and their personalities and they take such meticulous care with Pierre They go above and beyond.

Our dog typically has a lot of anxiety with regards to daycare and boarding, often hiding behind me when it’s time for me to depart. However, the last few times I’ve brought him to D Pet, he has been extremely excited to be there, which speaks to how well they treat him. The employees now know my dog by name, and when he stays overnight they are great about sending daily photos to let me know he’s alright. Cannot recommend this place enough!

Outstanding service and communication! Our baby was a little nervous at drop off for NEW and seems so happy and not traumatized when we picked her up.
Great staff and friends for our baby.

We highly recommend D Pet Hotels and will continue to use.
Our girls love this place! The staff is so sweet and attentive, and I feel very at-ease whenever I have to board them here. Very clean facility, too!

We have had a wonderful experience at D Pet Hotel over the last six months or so.  We have used them for boarding and for day care. The staff are truly wonderful and caring.  They know our two bulldogs very well and the dogs are usually happy to arrive to have a play day.  We get pictures of our boys each day they visit and we also get feedback on how they interacted with the other dogs who are visiting.  I highly recommend.

Thank you for the 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear about your positive experience. If you have any suggestions for how we can improve further, please feel free to reach out. We appreciate your support!

Love d pet- always have a great experience. They do a great job of keeping me updated with pictures and my dog always comes back happy and tired from playing!

Our dog isn’t always the easiest but dpet is so sweet with him and never makes us feel like an inconvenience the way other places might- really really appreciate them!!

Our puppy started going to D Pet Hotels last month, and today when I picked him up he wanted to go back in. The staff are so friendly and responsive, and they clearly love the dogs they take care of. He can't wait to go back!

Thank you for the 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a great experience with us. Our team works hard to provide exceptional service, and we hope to see you again soon. If you have any suggestions for improvement, please feel free to share.

First time with D Pet Hotel.  Needed to board my dog in a hurry when boarding place she normally goes to was unavailable.  Went searching online found D Pet Hotel.  Made a phone call, was given information/instructions by exceptional staff and was able to book a room immediately.  Upon dropping her off, was met by a wonderful engaging staff, and along her stay, had some of the best communications (text/pictures) ever; which kept me apprised of my dog's daily activities.  I would most definitely board my dog there again.  Kudos to Pet D Hotel .
Friendly staff, clean facility, and our dog is super excited every time we drop him off - and super happy (and tired) when we pick him up.  So glad I found you guys!

Thank you so much for the amazing 5-star review! We're thrilled to hear that you had a great experience with us. If you have any suggestions on how we can make your next visit even better, please let us know. We appreciate your support!

Thank you D Pet Hollywood! Because you saw something in Lolli that I couldn’t, she now gets to be a real dog. Thank you ALL for your amazing service, communication and the effort you make to keep our fur babies safe and happy.
Always a great time for my pup and they always send me pictures during the day of him having a great time! they also do a great job at reminding me of his vaccine expirations, which is so helpful!
Thank you so much for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our services. If you ever need anything in the future, feel free to reach out. We appreciate your support!

Thank you for the glowing 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience with us. We strive to provide top-notch service and look forward to welcoming you back soon. If you have any suggestions for improvement, feel free to share!

My dog has been going to D Pet since she was 9 months old. She loves it and we love how happy she is there. The staff are amazing, caring, and responsible. We know she is safe & has fun when she boards at DPet or attends Doggy Daycare.
The staff was amazing and took exceptional care of our older heeler.  If your in the area and need dog sitting - these guys are the best!

We’ve been taking our dog to D Pet Hotel not too long ago, and we absolutely love it! After checking out several places around Hollywood, this one really stands out. The staff is super friendly, and they’ve created such a warm and loving atmosphere for the pups. The facility is always clean, which is a huge plus! By the end of the day, our dog is totally worn out but so happy! If you’re looking for a great spot for your furry friend, I highly recommend giving this place a try!

My boy Percy loves D Pet Hotel! I boarded him there multiple times in 2024. He is reactive and requires some extra care, but the staff always knows how to handle him and make him comfortable. I can tell Percy loves everyone there- he’s always excited to see the staff. He gets plenty of private play time, and I ask for 2 extra potty walks throughout the day which the staff gives at no extra cost. Super appreciative of D Pet Hotels and everyone there, they go above and beyond for Percy! Highly recommend.

Sage, our pitty, loves the D Pet Hotel where she gets lots of love, exercise, and socializing! Josh, the owner, took a lot of time and care to go over all the details of Sage’s medications and diet when we dropped her off. The trainers who posted dog pics daily, were excellent, too!

My dog, Cali, absolutely loves D Pet Hotels Hollywood! We recently boarded her there during the holidays, and she had an amazing stay. The staff kept me updated with daily pictures, which gave me peace of mind and let me see how happy she was. We also use D Pet for daycare, and Cali is always excited to go. Thank you so much for taking such great care of her! I highly recommend D Pet Hotel Hollywood to anyone looking for a top-notch boarding or daycare facility.
Our favorite place, we’ve been going here and only here for 8 years. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my dogs — seriously.

Thank you for your fantastic 5-star review! We are delighted to hear that you had a great experience with us. We continuously strive to provide top-notch service to our customers. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!
Everyone here is so lovely and accommodating. Sputnik always has the most amazing time!

I wanted to update my review today, December 29, 2024. I have now been bringing Prince my dog for many years and just last week dropped off my daughter’s beautiful adopted kitty Hiccup. I cannot say enough amazing stuff about the D pet hotel and the Extraordinary owner Josh & Staff! At pick up, Our beloved kiddos were clean, healthy & happy. Even though it was the holidays and a very busy time, they managed to send pictures every day to my daughter of her kitty because it was her first time away from home. If they ever notice any issue, they call, text, email. They take it upon themselves to do something about it. Last summer we were  in Portugal & they dropped everything to take Prince to my vet in SM to follow up on a pre-DPet treatment issue. They had a hunch about something and they were right and they did all of that for me without asking for a penny- I love this place. Your dogs and/or cats are safe & happy here. Now, for my review from three years ago, no thing has changed only better…you can read on.

I have been bringing my dog Prince here for years. Everything about this place is wonderful. The staff, the ownership & facility. I usually board my dog at DPet when I go away because I know he’ll be able to play with other dogs his size all day long and be cared for and then be put into his own room with his  comfortable little bed. They keep everything in order so everyone gets their own food, their own toys. They text or email pictures to let you know how your pet is doing and who is made friends with. They really do go above and beyond. Are usually have him groomed on the last day there and I think it’s  reasonably priced and professionally done.  One time I boarded my dog and the staff noticed that he wasn’t his usual self. They were so on top of it ..... emailing me three times a day Even suggesting I cut my trip short. When I brought him to the vet, he said I was  very lucky the staff was so attentive &  looking out for him! They are always there when you email or call. I trust my dog with the D Pet Hotel🐶
Our Bernedoodle had an amazing “vacation” at D Pet. Worth the $$$.
Thank you so much for the kind words! We're thrilled to hear that you had a great experience with us. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we look forward to serving you again soon.
D Pet hotels always takes great care of my dog. Highly recommend

D Pet Hotels Hollywood has been the trusted caregivers for my pets since 2010 and they have NEVER let me down.  I find/have found their customer service and communication to be efficient, friendly, and accommodating; in person, the staff are always friendly and loving to my pets.  As for my pets themselves?   My boys know the neighborhood so their tails start wagging and excited whining starts up in my car when we're two blocks away.  I think that's a better recommendation than any human can give.

My dog went to daycare for 3 days in a row and despite the staff being very very kind by offering me a tour of the facilities and explaining their business model, my dog came back with kennel cough. He was fully vaccinated and they called …

D pet hotel takes such amazing care of my baby puppy Rocky! We left him there for 5 nights and often take him there for daycare to hang with his friends. The indoor play room is air conditioned which helps on hot days. Their hours and …
My Boston Terrier Eddie loves this place! I bring him for the day & have used them for boarding as well. The staff is great! We appreciate you!
Love the staff they are so caring and genuine. My dog loves coming she gets so excited to see them and her puppy friends.
